ops.title: synctransport HOME= child env is inert under daemonkit v0.20.9 passwd-home resolution
ops.description: internal/synctransport/transport.go:333 spawns children with Env: []string{"HOME="+home}. Since daemonkit v0.20.9 resolves home via the passwd DB and ignores HOME, the child's daemonkit-derived paths no longer honor this scoping — the intent is silently dead. Found by the wave-2 verify lane 2026-07-27; latent, not a test-pollution escape.

ops.text: child home-scoping intent restored (daemonkit-aware override or removal of the dead code) with a test
